_note: The paper accounts the bot runs. PAPER ONLY: virtual money, public price data, no exchange keys. Change a strategy's params here (or add an account) and the next run picks it up. A brand-new id starts a fresh account; changing params of an existing id keeps its balance and history. Optional per account: "tf" (candle size, default "timeframe"), "risk" (overrides of config.json risk rules, e.g. full allocation), "group"/"badge" (dashboard only).

accounts.label: EMA Crossover
accounts.why: Trend following: buys when the 20-hour average crosses above the 100-hour one.

accounts.label: RSI Dip-Buyer
accounts.why: Mean reversion: buys sharp dips (RSI under 35), sells on the bounce.

accounts.label: Donchian Breakout
accounts.why: Breakout: buys a new 100-hour high, exits on a 10-hour low.

accounts.label: Just Hold BTC
accounts.why: Benchmark: buys BTC once with all its money at the start and never sells.

accounts.label: Trend Filter (100-day SMA)
accounts.why: Holds BTC (fully) only while the last daily close is above its 100-day average, else cash. Passed the 2022-26 out-of-sample test.

accounts.label: Bollinger Squeeze (4h)
accounts.why: Waits for a quiet market (narrow bands), buys the breakout above the upper band. 1% risk per trade. Passed the out-of-sample test.

accounts.label: 3-Month Momentum
accounts.why: Holds BTC (fully) while its last 3-month return is positive, else cash. Passed the out-of-sample test.

accounts.label: Weekly DCA (52 weeks)
accounts.why: Benchmark: buys the same amount (₹5 lakh ÷ 52) every week for a year, never sells.
